s01075.summary: Queen Isolde faces Morvan across the silk bridge and denies his claim.
Isolde steps onto the bridge ordering Morvan back; he dares her.
The herald reports the east wall fallen; Isolde orders the gate held.
Isolde draws her blazing sword and charges, clashing with Morvan's shadow spear.
Defying Morvan, Isolde drives forward as smoke breaks and he roars.

s01051.summary: Juniper's family and a city buyer gather for the season's last press.
Colm hears breathing beneath the dripping cider and everyone goes still.
Oluwaseun asks about a basement; the sisters evasively say they never dig.
Juniper tastes the cider and firmly orders Colm to put down his harmonica.
Beata and Juniper agree it's early as the barrel's staves bulge.
Everyone recoils; Juniper calmly takes a mallet and sends them out quietly.
Alone, Juniper raises the mallet and waits as the barrel breathes.

pd_earnest_6.summary: Jack presents Algernon as his brother and scolds him for past disrespect.
Gwendolen demands to know Jack's real Christian name.
Jack quizzes Lady Bracknell and Algernon about his father's name.
Jack tears through the Army Lists and finds his father was Ernest John.
Jack calmly announces his name is Ernest and Gwendolen forgives him.
The three couples embrace, each exclaiming at last.
Lady Bracknell chides his triviality; Jack quips about being earnest.

s00000.summary: A flooded roller rink serves as courtroom; Adaeze stands without her client.
Lev mocks the client's hospital absence as convenient; Adaeze bristles.
The judge asks for a doctor's note and the lawyers squabble over email.
Lev moves to proceed in absentia, citing a waiver Adaeze denies.
Adaeze finds the waiver and insists the signature isn't her client's.
At the bench Adaeze accuses Lev of forging the waiver.
Judge Tran rubs the signature and finds the ink still wet.
Lev stammers excuses about smears and a re-signing.
A pale clerk appears with a felt-tip and admits Lev called it routine.
The judge seats Lev and grants dismissal with prejudice.
Adaeze exhales in relief and the judge adjourns over tea.

pd_dollhouse_5.summary: Rank knocks and Helmer reluctantly lets him in.
Rank praises the cosy rooms and jokes about the champagne he drank.
Nora probes his research; Rank hints at a fatal certainty.
Nora turns to fancy-dress costumes and Rank compliments her.

s01044.summary: Orrin and Sable creep into the moth-covered library.
Apprentice Tamsin nearly collides with them and says they don't belong.
Moths rise, Orrin draws, and all three tumble into the aisle.
Masked Vesper calms the moths and orders the lantern put down.

s01086.summary: In the final frame, the team waits on Annika needing ten pins.
Annika bowls a strong ball but leaves one pin standing.
Hank gloats she choked; Muriel restrains Deshawn.
Muriel steadies Annika, saying the pin has waited thirty years for them.
Annika steps up again and gently rolls the ball into the last pin.
The pin falls and the alley erupts as Deshawn hoists Annika.
Hank offers a sporting handshake and a playful threat for next year.

s01064.summary: Queen Idrissa halts Finnegan on the bridge and denies his brother exists.
Morgana strides from the fog and vouches for Finnegan.
Morgana reveals she is the brother; the dropped lute makes the bridge hum.

s01102.summary: In a rain-soaked tent, Marisol stands on a chair begging for attention.
Adebayo coaxes her down as she fights tears and Callum begs help.
Water pours in and three dive for the cake, landing in mud.
Marisol bursts out laughing and toasts the wettest wedding in the county.
Pia emerges with a kitten and Marisol leaps into Adebayo's arms.

pd_dollhouse_1.summary: Nora explains her secret debt and the scrimping it has required.
Nora describes copying work and her fantasy of a rich admirer.
Nora jumps up rejoicing at being free from care.
The bell rings and Krogstad arrives to see Helmer on bank business.
Mrs Linde asks about Krogstad and reveals she knew him years ago.

s00019.summary: Magnus leads a picker, an inspector, and a stranger into the tunnel.
Zuzu sees breathing mushrooms; Magnus insists they aren't moving.
The Stranger shows the caps shy from light and ignores Zuzu's question.
Abiola flags log discrepancies and Magnus brushes her off, walking faster.
Zuzu finds half a boot wrapped in a hairnet on the floor.
Magnus claims the boot belonged to a picker who quit.
A cap bends toward the Stranger and he orders everyone still.
Rustling approaches; the Stranger exposes Magnus for locking the gate.
Zuzu begs him to open the gate; Magnus confesses keys open the far door.
A cap rises and the Stranger produces a canister, choosing the other way.

s00003.summary: Down two in the final, Abebe throws a stone that dies short.
Dez calls the game; Abebe blames himself and Inez defends his slide.
Foreman Gus arrives and orders the lane cleared for shift change.
Inez begs for the end and Gus grants one stone.
Inez steadies Abebe's shaking hands before his throw.
Abebe's clean throw goes long and touches nothing; Gus checks his watch.

s01049.summary: Gloria calls another vote and pressures wavering Min-Jun.
Gloria needles silent Deez, who says he's saving his voice.
Deez slams his cup and argues the teenage defendant had only a toy.
Min-Jun intervenes as Deez accuses Gloria of deciding on day one.
Deez knocks Gloria's cards away and both vow not to leave.
The generator dies and the three sit motionless in the dark.

pd_dollhouse_6.summary: Helmer promises to change and begs Nora not to leave.
Nora dresses to leave, rejecting his pleas to wait or live as siblings.
Nora frees Helmer of obligation and they exchange rings and keys.
Helmer begs to write or help; Nora refuses anything from a stranger.
Nora describes the miracle needed for real marriage and departs.
Helmer finds the room empty, clings to hope, and hears the door shut.

s01104.summary: Marshal Dunmore rides to the water tower where Odessa and Lazarus wait.
Odessa explains the Whitaker brothers climbed the tower armed.
Lazarus asks if he'll shoot them and Dunmore answers with dry humor.
Fort Bell promises reinforcements by noon; Dunmore says too late.
Dunmore returns Odessa's rifle and walks to the ladder.
Odessa stops him for a wordless look before he climbs.

s01106.summary: Hazel confronts Jonah about always missing the ferry.
Eavesdropping Wendell butts in and Hazel sides with him.
Wendell's rained-out cricket joke makes Jonah and Hazel laugh.
The ferry horn sounds and Jonah quietly apologizes; Hazel accepts.

pd_earnest_2.summary: Cecily complains about German and teases about Uncle Jack's seriousness.
Cecily wishes Jack's wicked brother would visit; Prism disapproves.
They spar over diaries, memory, and Prism's lost three-volume novel.
Dr. Chasuble arrives and Cecily invents Prism's headache to pair them.
Chasuble's flustered metaphors flirt with Prism, who glares.
Prism suddenly discovers a headache and strolls off with Chasuble.

s01029.summary: Darryl smiles rigidly at his desk, narrating endless reorgs.
He types frantically, clutches a stapler, and recites corporate jargon.
Darryl cheers the silent office and sips from an empty mug.

pd_sisters_4.summary: Trofimov arrives impatiently and greets Lubov, who barely recognizes him.
Lubov weeps for her drowned son Grisha as Trofimov consoles her.
Lubov remarks on how Trofimov has aged, still a student.
Pischin begs for 240 roubles and Lubov has Gaev lend it.
Gaev grumbles about his sister and insults Yasha, who grins back.

s01052.summary: Sleepless Tamara floats alone in the cramped capsule.
She replays her identical upbeat log entry.
She takes out a creased photograph and returns it without looking.
She replays the next day's entry over and over, word for word.
She presses her palm to the cold porthole and wipes away fog.
Recording a new log, she cannot say morale is fine.

s01061.summary: Gregor rallies six vested employees with platitudes in a corporate escape room.
Todd finds a padlock and Beatrice reads a vague clue.
Gregor scolds Marcus for counting down; Marcus twitches.
Delilah points out the code written on the whiteboard behind Gregor.
The chest opens to reveal only a request to complete a survey.

s01022.summary: Mabel works the switchboard alone, connecting calls.
A stranger enters without knocking demanding the Harrisburg line.
Crowe claims railway board authority; Mabel doubts his paper.
Mabel calls Abernathy, who relents when Crowe mentions the six-ten freight.
Abernathy has her connect the sheriff's line too.
Toby bursts in reporting the east line's wire was cut.
Mabel questions Crowe; Toby spots copper wire in his satchel.
The sheriff comes on the line and Mabel has Toby lock Crowe in.
